_comment: Gold Motion Library v0.3-draft —— 来源：Face Ritual Research Sprint 3 v0.3 的 20 个优先动作。
⚠️ 该文档开头即声明：「这是研究/产品设计草案，不是最终医疗或专业安全认证。
所有动作在上线前仍需 Human Expert Gate，尤其眼周、颈部、TMJ、口腔/舌及工具类。」
因此全部条目 reviewStatus = draft，UI 会显示未审核角标，CI 会拦截发布。
- 用户可见字段（title / shortCue / voiceCue / safetyNote）为英文，面向欧美用户。
- source.* 逐字保留中文原文，**不翻译**：安全相关措辞经翻译会引入偏差，
而 Expert Gate 审的正是这些。英文 safetyNote 属翻译，必须对照 stopSignalsZh 复核。
- evidenceLevel 只用于排序与风险判断。Sprint 3 §1：
「不把研究中出现过的动作等同于已被单独证明有效；证据只决定优先级与风险边界。」
**不得**用于任何对外功效表述。
GM-19 / GM-20 是工具类，Sprint 3 §9 明确不得作为免费 Morning Core 的必要条件，
因此 allowedRoutineTypes 只有 quick，校验器会拦截它们进入 morning routine。

moves.title: Settle and Breathe
moves.voiceCue: Breathe in through your nose. Breathe out slowly, and let your brow, jaw and shoulders soften.
moves.safetyNote: If you feel light-headed, return to normal breathing.

source.titleZh: 面部放松呼吸 / Neutral Face Reset
source.evidenceZh: 辅助动作；低风险、习惯锚定价值高
source.startingPositionZh: 肩膀放松，嘴唇自然闭合或微张，牙齿不咬紧，舌头自然。
source.instructionZh: 鼻吸气，缓慢呼气；呼气时主动放松眉间、下颌和肩膀。保持面部中立，不做强表情。
source.stopSignalsZh: 如有头晕则恢复正常呼吸。
source.usageZh: Morning/Evening 开场；不作为美容功效动作。
source.researchNoteZh: 目的主要是降低动作开始前的面部/下颌紧张和建立仪式感。

moves.title: Forehead Sweep
moves.voiceCue: Fingertips at the centre of your forehead. Glide outwards to the temples, then lift off.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if the skin feels sensitive, hot, or looks noticeably red.

source.titleZh: 额头中央 → 太阳穴轻柔外扫
source.evidenceZh: 经典 facial massage / effleurage；机制与实践支持，直接长期美容证据有限
source.startingPositionZh: 双手2–3指指腹放在额头中央，左右对称。
source.instructionZh: 沿额头水平或轻微向外上方滑向太阳穴；到太阳穴后抬手复位，不逆向拖回。
source.intensityZh: 轻压，皮肤可移动但不应被大幅拉扯
source.stopSignalsZh: 敏感、灼热、明显发红时停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 需要润滑。拍摄时明确“outward”而非快速摩擦。

moves.title: Forehead Lift
moves.voiceCue: Slide slowly upwards to the hairline, then lift your hands away.
moves.safetyNote: Don't rub over skin that is irritated or sunburnt.

source.titleZh: 额头向上 / 发际线轻扫
source.evidenceZh: 经典按摩手法；低风险候选
source.startingPositionZh: 指腹位于眉毛上方/额头下部。
source.instructionZh: 向上缓慢滑至发际线，抬手复位。左右手可交替或同时。
source.stopSignalsZh: 不要在明显受刺激/晒伤皮肤上摩擦。
source.researchNoteZh: 不宣称“抹平额纹”；定位为按摩/放松。

moves.title: Forehead Circles
moves.voiceCue: Small slow circles, moving gradually outwards.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if the friction feels uncomfortable.

source.titleZh: 额头小圆周按摩
source.evidenceZh: 传统/专业按摩常见；低直接证据
source.startingPositionZh: 双手指腹置于额头两侧或中央。
source.instructionZh: 做小而慢的圆周，逐步从中央移动到外侧；不要原地高速摩擦。
source.stopSignalsZh: 皮肤摩擦不适即停止。
source.usageZh: Evening 优先；Morning 可替代 GM-03。
source.researchNoteZh: 与GM-02/03功能重叠，最终 Core 不应三者全部占用时间。

moves.title: Between the Brows
moves.voiceCue: Rest a finger between your brows. Press gently, then make very small circles.
moves.safetyNote: Stop immediately if a headache worsens or the skin feels uncomfortable. Do not touch the eyeball.

source.titleZh: 眉间轻压 + 微小圆周
source.evidenceZh: 2025 face-yoga/按摩 protocol family + 传统实践；单动作效果未独立证实
source.startingPositionZh: 一至两指指腹放在两眉之间的皮肤/肌肉区域，不接触眼球。
source.instructionZh: 轻柔静压1–2秒，再做非常小的圆周；保持眉毛放松。
source.stopSignalsZh: 头痛加重、疼痛或皮肤不适立即停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 不能宣传穴位治疗作用；如果以后加入中医解释，应放在可选 Why this movement。

moves.title: Temple Circles
moves.voiceCue: Slow, small circles at your temples. Keep your jaw relaxed.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if you get a headache or feel dizzy. Don't press hard.

source.titleZh: 太阳穴轻柔圆周
source.evidenceZh: 广泛实践；舒缓用途合理，长期美容证据有限
source.startingPositionZh: 食指/中指指腹置于太阳穴软组织处。
source.instructionZh: 做缓慢小圆周，保持下颌放松；不要用力压迫。
source.stopSignalsZh: 头痛、眩晕或不适停止。
source.usageZh: Morning/Evening；眼周外围安全替代候选。
source.researchNoteZh: 比直接眼睑动作更适合第一版。

moves.title: Cheek Lifter
moves.shortCue: Open an O, then lift the cheeks
moves.voiceCue: Make an O shape with your mouth, cover your top teeth with your lip, then smile to lift your cheeks.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if your jaw joint hurts, cramps, or feels tired.

source.titleZh: Cheek Lifter（短版原型）
source.evidenceZh: 2018 JAMA方案包含并公开描述；方案级结果支持脸颊丰满度，单动作效应未知
source.startingPositionZh: 张口形成“O”形，上唇尽量覆盖上牙；指腹轻放在上颊作为触觉提示。
source.instructionZh: 保持O形，尝试用笑的方式把脸颊肌肉向上提；放松后再次提起。手指只感受运动，不强推皮肤。
source.stopSignalsZh: 出现颌关节疼痛、抽筋或明显疲劳即停止。
source.usageZh: Morning Core 候选；需专家确认短版是否合理。
source.researchNoteZh: 原研究练习剂量远长于15秒；MVP短版不得声称复制原研究效果。

moves.title: Happy Cheeks Sculpting
moves.voiceCue: Smile without showing your teeth, purse your lips, and lift your cheeks. Hold.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if your jaw joint is uncomfortable or the muscles around your mouth cramp.

source.titleZh: Happy Cheeks Sculpting（20秒版）
source.evidenceZh: 2018 JAMA方案公开描述；方案级脸颊结果
source.startingPositionZh: 不露牙微笑，嘴唇轻轻噘起/收拢。
source.instructionZh: 保持闭口微笑并主动把脸颊肌肉向上提；手指可从嘴角轻触向上到脸颊顶部作为位置提示，不要拉扯皮肤。
source.stopSignalsZh: TMJ不适或口周抽筋停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 公开原始描述为约20秒保持；适配我们的15–20秒节奏较自然。

moves.title: Cheek Puff
moves.voiceCue: Close your lips and puff both cheeks evenly. Don't squeeze them with your hands.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if your jaw joint is uncomfortable, or if you feel dizzy or short of breath.

source.titleZh: 双颊鼓气 / Cheek Puff
source.evidenceZh: 2025 face-yoga protocol family；肌群级研究支持但样本小
source.startingPositionZh: 嘴唇闭合，牙齿不咬紧。
source.instructionZh: 在口腔内充气使双颊均匀鼓起；保持，不要用手挤压脸颊。
source.stopSignalsZh: 颌关节不适、头晕或呼吸不顺时停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 可进一步测试“左右转移气体”是否必要；首版建议先用双侧静态版，简单且容易拍。

moves.title: A–O–I–U
moves.voiceCue: Shape A, then O, then I, then U. Slow and controlled, never forced.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if your jaw joint hurts, clicks painfully, or cramps.

source.titleZh: A-O-I-U 元音面部运动
source.evidenceZh: 2025 face-yoga protocol 明确使用元音动作；样本12人、无对照
source.startingPositionZh: 自然坐姿，牙齿不咬紧。
source.instructionZh: 依次缓慢夸张但不疼痛地做 A → O → I → U 口型；重点是可控而非最大幅度。
source.stopSignalsZh: TMJ疼痛、咔哒伴痛或痉挛停止。
source.usageZh: Quick Ritual 或 Core 备选。
source.researchNoteZh: 视觉传播性强，但动态表情较多；需专家评估是否适合每日固定Core。

moves.title: Midface Sweep
moves.shortCue: From beside the nose out to the cheekbone
moves.voiceCue: Start beside your nose and glide out and up along the cheekbone.
moves.safetyNote: Go around any inflamed spots or broken skin. Stop if it hurts.

source.titleZh: 鼻翼/中脸 → 颧骨外上轻扫
source.evidenceZh: 经典 facial massage；方向与多个工具 protocol 相近
source.startingPositionZh: 两侧指腹位于鼻翼旁/中脸内侧，不压鼻孔。
source.instructionZh: 沿颧骨下方或脸颊上部向外上滑至耳前/太阳穴方向；抬手复位。
source.stopSignalsZh: 痤疮炎症、皮损或摩擦疼痛处绕开。
source.researchNoteZh: 不使用“提升/消除法令纹”的确定性文案。

moves.title: Cheek to Temple
moves.voiceCue: Glide slowly from the cheek out towards the temple.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if you feel pain, dragging, or irritation. Keep the skin well lubricated.

source.titleZh: 颧骨下缘 / 脸颊 → 太阳穴外扫
source.evidenceZh: 2025 Gua Sha/Roller protocol 有相似方向；徒手应用属间接证据
source.startingPositionZh: 指腹/掌根置于脸颊内侧或颧骨下方。
source.instructionZh: 沿脸颊向外、向太阳穴方向缓慢滑动；保持皮肤有润滑。
source.stopSignalsZh: 出现疼痛、明显拉扯或刺激停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 可与GM-11二选一或做不同高度层次。

moves.title: Palm Effleurage
moves.shortCue: Palms glide up towards the ears
moves.voiceCue: Use the base of your palms. Glide smoothly from the lower cheek up towards the ears.
moves.safetyNote: Lighten the pressure or skip this over sensitive or inflamed areas.

source.titleZh: 脸颊掌根外上 Effleurage
source.evidenceZh: 基础按摩手法；实践成熟
source.startingPositionZh: 掌根/手掌外侧轻贴下脸颊。
source.instructionZh: 从中下脸颊向耳前和外上方平滑移动；动作连续、慢。
source.intensityZh: 轻至中轻，不造成明显变形
source.stopSignalsZh: 敏感皮肤或炎症区域减轻力度/跳过。
source.researchNoteZh: 比指尖动作更有“被护理”感，但拍摄时容易遮脸，需要调整机位。

moves.title: Cheek Circles
moves.voiceCue: Small circles on the cheek, drifting slowly outwards.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if the skin feels irritated. Keep it well lubricated.

source.titleZh: 脸颊小圆周揉动
source.evidenceZh: 经典 massage / petrissage light；直接证据有限
source.startingPositionZh: 指腹或两三指平贴脸颊。
source.instructionZh: 做小圆周并缓慢向外移动，不在同一点高速搓。
source.stopSignalsZh: 皮肤摩擦刺激停止。
source.usageZh: Evening 或 Quick；Morning Core 备选。
source.researchNoteZh: 需足够润滑。

moves.title: Light Tapping
moves.voiceCue: Tap lightly with your fingertips across the cheeks, forehead and jawline.
moves.safetyNote: Skip this if your skin is painful, very sensitive, or reactive. Avoid the eyes and the bridge of the nose.

source.titleZh: 全脸/脸颊轻拍 Tapotement
source.evidenceZh: 传统按摩手法；即时“唤醒感”强，长期美容证据弱
source.startingPositionZh: 双手指腹放松。
source.instructionZh: 用指腹快速但极轻地交替点拍脸颊、额头、下颌外侧，避开眼球和鼻梁骨性敏感点。
source.stopSignalsZh: 疼痛/敏感/玫瑰痤疮明显刺激时跳过。
source.researchNoteZh: 定位为 sensory/ritual 动作，不做疗效承诺。

moves.title: Soft Pucker
moves.shortCue: Purse the lips forward, then release
moves.voiceCue: Slowly purse your lips forward into a soft O. Hold, then release.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if the muscles around your mouth cramp or your jaw joint is uncomfortable.

source.titleZh: Kiss / Pucker / O 口型收缩
source.evidenceZh: 2018/2025 face-exercise families 中有相似动作；单动作证据有限
source.startingPositionZh: 下颌放松，嘴唇自然。
source.instructionZh: 缓慢把嘴唇向前收成柔和O/亲吻形，保持1–2秒后放松；不需要最大用力。
source.stopSignalsZh: 口周痉挛或TMJ不适停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 动态口周动作可能增加部分用户对纹路的顾虑；需用户测试。

moves.title: Above the Upper Lip
moves.voiceCue: Very small circles above the upper lip, moving out towards the corners.
moves.safetyNote: Skip this if you have a cold sore, broken skin, irritation, or any infection. Stay off the lip itself.

source.titleZh: 上唇周围轻柔小圆周
source.evidenceZh: 2025 protocol family 有口周按摩；具体单动作需补全文核验
source.startingPositionZh: 洁净指腹放在上唇外侧皮肤，避开唇红黏膜。
source.instructionZh: 做非常小的圆周，从中央向两侧移动。
source.stopSignalsZh: 唇疱疹、破损、刺激或感染时跳过。
source.researchNoteZh: 不宣传“消除唇纹/法令纹”。

moves.title: Jawline Sweep
moves.shortCue: Along the jaw towards the ear
moves.voiceCue: From the centre of your chin, glide slowly along the jawline towards the ear.
moves.safetyNote: Stop if your jaw joint hurts, your neck feels uncomfortable, or the skin is irritated. Avoid pressing deeply into the side of the neck.

source.titleZh: 下巴 → 下颌线 → 耳前轻扫
source.evidenceZh: 经典按摩 + 2025工具协议相似方向；徒手证据为间接
source.startingPositionZh: 指腹/掌侧置于下巴中央或下颌边缘。
source.instructionZh: 沿下颌骨轮廓缓慢向耳前滑动；到耳前抬手复位。避免深压颈动脉区域。
source.stopSignalsZh: TMJ疼痛、颈部不适或皮肤刺激停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 动作易理解、传播性高；产品文案避免“永久塑造jawline”。

moves.title: Facial Roller — Outward
moves.voiceCue: Roll gently outwards. One direction at a time, then lift and start again.
moves.safetyNote: Don't use over broken or inflamed skin. Stop if it hurts or if you bruise easily.

source.titleZh: Facial Roller 标准外向 Protocol（工具专项）
source.evidenceZh: 2018局部血流人体研究 + 2025随机对照试验，工具类证据较强
source.startingPositionZh: 使用清洁roller，皮肤有适当润滑；从下脸/脸颊开始。
source.instructionZh: 以轻柔压力，从面部中央向外滚动；下颌向耳前、脸颊向太阳穴、额头向外/向上。每次只向一个方向滚，再抬起复位。
source.durationZh: Quick Ritual 建议3–5分钟；不塞入免费 Morning Core
source.stopSignalsZh: 破损/发炎皮肤、疼痛、瘀青风险或不适停止。
source.researchNoteZh: 论文原干预剂量约10分钟/次、每周5次、8周；我们的短版必须明确是体验型产品设计，不能声称等效。

moves.title: Gua Sha — Outward
moves.voiceCue: Keep the tool flat against the skin. Slow, single-direction strokes outwards.
moves.safetyNote: Very light pressure on the face — this is not meant to leave marks. Stop for pain, marked redness, bruising, broken or inflamed skin, or if you bruise or bleed easily.

source.titleZh: Gua Sha 下颌/脸颊/额头外向 Protocol（工具专项）
source.evidenceZh: 2025随机对照试验 protocol；目前优先级较高的工具路线
source.startingPositionZh: 清洁、光滑边缘工具 + 足够润滑；工具尽量平贴皮肤而非用尖角。
source.instructionZh: 下巴/下颌向耳前，脸颊向太阳穴，额头向外/向上；单向、慢、轻柔，抬起复位。
source.intensityZh: 面部非常轻；不追求出痧/瘀点
source.stopSignalsZh: 疼痛、明显红斑、瘀青、破损/炎症皮肤、出血风险等情况停止或避免。
source.researchNoteZh: Cleveland Clinic强调面部使用很轻压力；首版不进入3分钟Hands Only Core。
